title: Sorrowful Chapelier - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Sorrowful Chapelier in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The third mask attached to the Visages Axon. It shares the Fire and Dark weakness of the other two Vale bosses, so the same party clears all three without rebuilding.

sections.title: How to Beat the Sorrowful Chapelier
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
